manifest.name: Service Browser
manifest.description: Opens the web interface of a Service, Pod or Ingress in a browser next to the editor, through KubeBench's proxy, isolated from KubeBench.

page.noPortsHint: The object declares no TCP port, so there is nothing a browser can show.

toolbar.label: Browser
toolbar.newTab: Open in a new browser tab

notice.sandboxed: The page runs sandboxed, isolated from KubeBench: it cannot use cookies or storage, so some apps (for example ones with a sign-in) do not work here.
notice.proxyOrigin: The page runs on the separate proxy origin, isolated from KubeBench.
notice.readOnly: The cluster is read-only: only GET requests are sent, so forms that post data are refused.

mock.title: Demo page
mock.body: Demo mode has no cluster to connect to. With a live cluster this tab shows the service's own web interface.

ingress.noRoutesHint: The Ingress has no rule or default backend that leads to a Service port, so there is nothing a browser can show.
ingress.via: {{address}}, reached through Service {{service}} with the rule's host. Path rewrites of the ingress controller do not apply.
